title: A/P Unpaid Invoices lists each vendor's lines oldest first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendor Y has three unpaid bills dated on three different days.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  3. Open vendor Y's group.
  4. Read the Date column top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • oldest at the top, newest at the bottom.

Why this matters: Older bills are paid first.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountPayable/Service/DbalApUnpaidInvoicesFetcher.php:114. V1 code, quoted: `' ORDER BY vendorName ASC, transactionDate ASC'`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-152) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY
